Thanks for the heads-up and for keeping HR in the loop. A few HR notes / constraints to keep top of mind: 

1) Confidentiality: Please do not copy the employee on this thread. Share manager notes with the employee only during a private 1:1 or joint meeting (manager + HR).

2) Language guidance: avoid words that imply finality (e.g., "termination", "failure"). Use "targeted development plan" or "performance support plan" instead. Be specific about expected behaviors and durations.

3) Accommodation and history: I checked the HRIS; there are no formal accommodations on file for Neha. If you have informal notes that matter, share them with me directly (not in a broad thread).

4) Process & timing: HR recommends the following sequence —
   - Manager delivers private check-in with HR present to document outcomes.
   - If a plan is agreed, document it with 30/60/90 checkpoints and share the note with the employee within 48 hours.
   - If an org change is necessary, we communicate to stakeholders after the employee has agreed and transition tasks are mapped.

I've uploaded our standard confidential guidance and a short manager checklist here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExamplePrivateLink (access restricted). Attached: confidential-performance-guidelines.pdf
